description: Simulates buying a fixed amount of a crypto pair on a schedule over past daily prices and returns invested, value, average cost and return. 0.002 USDC per call via x402.

amount.description: Amount per buy in quote currency

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.
